title: Starbucks Passion Tea Lemonade (5-min Copycat Recipe)
description: A simple recipe to recreate the iconic, vibrant, and refreshing caffeine-free Passion Tea Lemonade from Starbucks at home. This drink is more than just a thirst-quencher, it’s a whole mood. With its fruity burst and refreshing vibe, it’s the best drink to sip in summers. Plus, it’s a breeze to make and guaranteed to impress.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
instructions:
Step 1: Brew the Tea Concentrate
Bring 2 cups of filtered water to a boil. Remove from heat. Add 4 Tazo Passion tea bags. Let them steep for 5 to 7 minutes. Do not steep longer.


Step 2: Chill the Tea Completely
Discard the tea bags. Pour the concentrate into a pitcher or jar. Chill in the fridge for at least an hour until fully cold.


Step 3: Assemble & Shake
Fill your cocktail shaker (or mason jar) with ice. Add equal parts chilled tea and lemonade. Pour in simple syrup to taste.


Step 4: Shake Vigorously & Serve
Secure the lid and shake hard for about 15 seconds. It should look frosty and a bit foamy. Strain into a tall glass filled with ice.
notes:
Make-Ahead Master: Brew a larger batch of concentrate. Mix with lemonade in a pitcher. Keep chilled. When ready, shake with ice for a fresh glass.

Don't Squeeze the Tea Bags: Avoid squeezing them after steeping. This can release bitterness into your drink.

Taste and Adjust: Everyone likes their drink a little different. Taste and adjust the sweetness to your liking.
